title: ひらいたひらいた (Hiraita Hiraita — It Opened, It Opened)
description: A gentle circle game song about lotus flowers (れんげ) blooming at dawn and closing by noon. Children hold hands in a circle and expand outward on 'ひらいた' (opened) and contract inward on 'つぼんだ' (closed). The alternating open/close pattern makes this a perfect first movement song for young children. Traditional anonymous song.
